name: pred-provable
description: Provable KPI Markets: outcome-token markets resolved by on-chain account reads
author: Ronaldo Pereira

scripts.build:program: NO_DNA=1 anchor build && bun run sync-idl
scripts.sync-idl: bun run --filter @pred-provable/app sync-idl && mkdir -p packages/sdk/src/idl && cp target/idl/brot_markets.json target/types/brot_markets.ts packages/sdk/src/idl/
scripts.test:rust: cargo test -p pred-provable --features no-entrypoint && cargo test -p brot-markets --features no-entrypoint
scripts.deploy:devnet: solana program deploy target/deploy/pred_provable.so --program-id target/deploy/pred_provable-keypair.json --keypair $HOME/.config/solana/pred-provable-devnet.json --url devnet
scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .husky || echo "git hooks not installed (not a git repository?)"
